clues.description: Massive plasma landing crater on crushed BNL scrap towers! Matches the thrusters of EVE's scout drop-ship.
Hal's favorite 3x3 Rubik's cube artifact perched in the scrap dunes.
Antique 'Hello, Dolly!' cassette tape found in the debris; magnetic tape points toward fresh hover trails.
Intact tungsten lightbulb found preserved in an old refrigerator; filament glows with static charge from EVE's passage.
Fresh ionized hover turbulence in the dusty air, ionized particles swirling down-canyon.
Vintage red CO2 fire extinguisher; nozzle frost traces show sub-zero antigravity discharge.
Compacted scrap cube with laser-cut markings from EVE's high-yield plasma arm cannon.
Collectible silver spork discovered half-buried near ancient BnL fast food debris.
Weathered red Buy n Large cooler chest containing vintage trinkets.
Direct ping response on WALL-E's radio compass matching Axiom Class-A probe telemetry.
Reflective chrome vehicle hubcap embedded in sand, mirroring the high-altitude cloud cover.
Velvet jewelry case with intact diamond ring, discarded by WALL-E to keep the elegant case.
THE LIVING SEEDLING! A fragile green plant growing inside a worn leather work boot. The directive objective!
